summary: Forest County lookout listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; OpenStreetMap types it as an observation tower. No build, staffing or fire record found.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no removal date found

evidence.supports: the tower is listed in Forest County at 45.38092, -88.45314 and marked as gone
the OpenStreetMap node is named McCaslin Lookout Tower
OpenStreetMap types the structure as an observation tower
the Central US Lookouts Wisconsin index places McCaslin in Forest County
Wisconsin decided in 2016 to close its last 72 operating fire lookout towers, a statewide fact not specific to this tower
evidence.quote: The state of Wisconsin decided to close its last 72 operating fire lookout towers in 2016.

notes_for_editor: Stub: the story is about 90 words, below the 120-word floor, because the only sources are two index listings, an OpenStreetMap node and one statewide line. No build, staffing, fire or site record was found. The Forest Service Chequamegon-Nicolet fire lookout PDF (fs.usda.gov/Internet/FSE_DOCUMENTS/stelprd3843401.pdf) and the Forest Service Quartz Hill trail page returned HTTP 504 to both fetch_text and WebFetch; retry them before publishing. A search snippet described McCaslin Mountain on the Quartz Hill trail with no tower on its summit. That is a place name, not evidence about this tower, and it is not used in the story.
